The '''''Ootmian Pabol''''' ('''Outlanders' Route''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]<ref name="suvudu1">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2009-08-18|quote=I coined Pabol as the Huttese word for "route" (it's a corruption of "spaceship" + "go") and joined it with other Huttese words. The Ootmian Pabol was the Outlanders' Route (listen closely in Episode I and you'll hear Watto mutter about ootmians), the Shag Pabol was the Slave Road, and the Pabol Hutta spoke for itself.}}</ref>), a corruption of the formally named '''''Ootmian Pankapolla''''', was a major [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] that led into the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] connecting it to commerce powers of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] along the route included [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]], [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle Prime]], [[Ota]], [[Randon/Legends|Randon]], [[Ubrikkia/Legends|Ubrikkia]], [[Kwenn/Legends|Kwenn]], [[Keldooine/Legends|Keldooine]], [[Nar Bo Sholla]], [[Irith]], [[Du Hutta]], [[Nar Hekka]] and finally [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] at its terminus.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
In [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] scouts connected Hutt Space with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Nal Hutta became a thriving boomworld.

Circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the star of the [[Kyyr system]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], decimating the route in that region. In its place laid the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]], and at the center, the [[Thornhedge Pulsar]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[spacer/Legends|Spacers]] initially found other ways to make their way into the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], however interest was also directed to the newly discovered [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. Traffic to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] diminished, and from a commercial center it reduced to a [[shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], albeit the greatest in [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
